rows.DESCRIPTION:
MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5721 m to 5742 m, with 15-30 klbf, 80-120 rpm, 25-33 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2550 psi.

Notes:
- EDS#4 (CSR+UBSR).
- Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%.
- MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9,80 ppg.
- Using PWD internal gauge to estimate ECD and to calibrate MPD model.
- Backreaming 20 m at 5723 m and 5731 m due to surface torque increasing.
- Backreaming 5 m at 5737 m due to low ROP and backreaming 30 m at 5740 due to low ROP and BHA vibration.
- Observing stall with 33 klbf.ft at 5739 m.
- Observing MRIL tool failure at 5739 m.

MW: Troubleshooting MRIL tool.

Obs.:
- Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, without sucess.

MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5742 m to 5747 m, with 15-37 klbf, 80 rpm, 25-32 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2550 psi.

Notes:
- Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%.
- MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9,80 ppg.
- Observing failure to receive M/LWD signal.

MW: Troubleshooting M/LWD tools.

Obs.:
- Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, with sucess.

text_blocks.translated_text: MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5747 m to 5749 m

text_blocks.text:
Tentando assentar string nas cunhas, sem sucesso. Tentando ajustar balanço da sonda, sem sucesso.
Nota: Foi necessário mudar o rumo da sonda para permitir operação com barco de apoio.
text_blocks.translated_text:
Trying to set string on slips, without success. Trying to adjust rig balance, without success.
Note: It was necessary to change rig heading to allow operation with supply boat.

rows.DESCRIPTION:
MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5747 m to 5749 m, with 12-15 klbf, 70 rpm, 24-25 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2600 psi.

Notes:
- Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%.
- MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9,80 ppg.
- Flushing kill and choke lines.
- Observing another failure to receive M/LWD signal.

MW: Troubleshooting M/LWD tools.

Obs.:
- Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, without sucess.

MW: Performing dynamic flow check during 15 min, OK. POOH 1 stand keeping SBP to pressurize well with 9.8 ppg + 120 psi at the casing shoe. B/D drilling stand.

Obs.:
- Selecting EDS#5 (CSR+LBSR / EHBS: LBSR).
- In parallel, holding a pre job safety meeting prior to POOH BHA #5.
MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA on DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 5741 m to 5702 m in open hole, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand.
